text:
I feel the stimulating hum of intellectual activity. In the first scene, the glass-walled room invites me inside—a space of collaboration and focus, filled with soft conversation and the glow of a projected screen. Observing from outside, I sense both separateness and curiosity, as if on the cusp of insight.

Stepping into the second scene, vivid colors and bold letters beckon me. I am drawn to the words 'R + D'—research and development—a realm of possibility and invention. The energy here is playful and bright, yet purposeful. The exhibition radiates an optimism about creation and learning. I feel inspired, reminded of the infinite paths of discovery and the joy of connecting ideas.
